info.name: Qiskit Runtime Analytics Accounts Workloads API

params.name: user
params.description: User identifier. For now it can only be "me".

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the workloads by. A `-` prefix indicates descending sort order.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of workloads to return at a time

params.name: previous
params.description: Cursor to previous workloads result page

params.name: next
params.description: Cursor to next workloads result page

params.name: search
params.description: Optional search string, used to filter workloads by id or tags

params.name: status
params.description: Status type to filter workloads by. It can be pending, in_progress, failed, completed or canceled.

params.name: mode
params.description: Workload mode: job, session or batch

params.name: created_after
params.description: Filter jobs and session created after this date

params.name: created_before
params.description: Filter jobs and session created before this date

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional array of tags for the workloads
